verified: Maximum takes precedence over minimum; calibration and warmup consume the budget.
Zero maximum disables work even with include-ignored; a positive override reenables selection.
Measured-only accounting charges at least 1 ns per workload call. Zero raw observations remain zero and a run note explains the accounting floor.
native_differences: Airbug full-work accounting sums workload call wall times, including their setup/drop. Divan accounts initial start through latest sample end, also including intervening coordination.
Airbug stores nanoseconds; Divan uses picoseconds. Threaded Airbug samples sum slowest wave durations; Divan uses the slowest whole-worker sample. See thread-sampling.json.
The 1 ns floor guarantees budget progress, not fast completion for arbitrarily large minimum times.
